lastPrompt: Keep related products out of the default product-page prefetch, but have them ready immediately when navigating from the featured-product link.

content.text:
This is a Next.js 16 canary app using **Cache Components** (`cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`), where the shape of the render tree — not custom prefetch code — determines what's included in a default `<Link>` prefetch.

Currently `app/product/page.tsx` awaits `getRelatedProducts()` inline, so it's part of the static shell and gets pulled into every default prefetch of `/product`. I'll split it into two pieces:

1. Move the related-products fetch into its own component wrapped in `<Suspense>` — this excludes it from the default static-shell prefetch (any plain link to `/product` skips it).
2. On the homepage's featured-product `<Link>`, set `prefetch={true}` to force a full prefetch (including the Suspense content) specifically for that link, so related products are already cached and ready by the time the user lands on the page.
